faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.subtitle: What brands and businesses usually ask before getting started.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on production type, duration, locations and deliverables. We work with tailored quotes: tell us your idea and we'll respond with a clear proposal, no surprises.

items.question: Do you only do video or also manage social media?
items.answer: Both. We can handle production, social content and community management. One team, one visual vision.

items.question: Do you work outside Valencia?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in Valencia and cover projects across Spain. Travel costs are quoted upfront when needed.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: It varies by project. A reel can be ready in a few days; corporate video or event coverage typically takes 1–3 weeks. We give you concrete timelines in the proposal.

items.question: What does the workflow look like?
items.answer: Brief, strategy, production, post-production and delivery. At every stage you know what to expect and who you're talking to. No middlemen or rotating teams.

items.question: We're a small brand — can we start small?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients start with a single video or a monthly content pack. We scale with you when you need it.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Passion for telling stories that impact
about.content:
24Shoots is an audiovisual production company and content agency based in Valencia. We combine video, photography, social media management and drone to help brands and businesses communicate with impact.

Our motto — Master the impact — sums up what we seek in every project: content that doesn't go unnoticed and delivers real results.
